anchors.description: White cylindrical drum lampshade of the bedside lamp at right; horizontal 3D diameter across the shade silhouette.
anchors.visible_evidence: Shade is a clean bright drum against a dark wall, left and right silhouette edges visible at 471 and 591 px on the same row; measured width 120 px at mid-height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Unbranded generic shade; drum shades for bedside lamps commonly run 12-17 in diameter, nominal 14 in assumed.

anchors.description: White plantation-shutter louvers on the far-wall window; vertical span of five consecutive louver pitches.
anchors.visible_evidence: Regular horizontal louver lines on the white shutter panel; row profile at x 130-190 shows bright louver edges every 10 px (148,158,168,178,188,198), i.e. five pitches between the two points.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Louver blade width not legible; standard widths are 2.5, 3.5 and 4.5 in; 3.5 in (0.089 m) assumed, so the 5-pitch span is 0.32-0.58 m.
